posts.text: Real talk: I have spent the last two weeks evaluating six outbound tools. All of them want $800/month and produce emails that sound like they were written by a LinkedIn influencer's intern. We need better.
Our infra team grew from 2 to 5 this quarter. The bottleneck is no longer engineering. The bottleneck is now finding customers who actually need what we built.
Looking for a founding AE. YC alum or equivalent. Has done outbound at a technical product company. Comfortable owning the entire pipeline. Equity-heavy. DMs open.
